name: Ordo
description: Ordo is Echelon Foundry's State-Directed Engineering methodology. It makes state, evidence, legal actions, obligations, uncertainty, and external-effect outcomes explicit so humans and AI agents can make bounded changes without reconstructing the system's meaning from incidental code.
footerNote: Ordo is Echelon Foundry's State-Directed Engineering methodology. The public site separates implemented semantics, measured evidence, engineering guidance, and open research questions so claims stay inside what the evidence supports.
